comment.body: The requested line-folding operation is distinct from plain-text paste: plain text removes rich formatting but normally retains real paragraph/newline characters. Removing those characters globally would alter other users' text. The useful follow-up is an explicit opt-in remove-line-breaks transformation, with soft wrapping and real paragraph breaks kept distinct; #35587 is related feature context, not evidence of an already shipped fix.
